notes.title: Announcing Tank Brawl 2 - Brutal brawl of steel monsters!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Tank Brawl 2 will be available later this year with very very ambitious features. We want to make the best tank shooter ever with 100 wow moments.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BrEz1zjG3oo
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/5a7e8abd21a0cec4cce258a168e110c40cb4a0f9.jpg

Free 3 vs 3 Team multiplayer battle
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/b0616debc1e52cdbea10cd38835c6cd38e0da436.jpg

Combine vehicle and driver classes to make hundred different playable classes (Inspired by Titan Quest class system).
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/c3a2362ee9923bbf4d6ae1ec60e428f3cdda8167.jpg

Drive Jeeps, Tanks, Giant Mechs or the brutal Mobile Rocket Launchers. Each with its own unique game-play mechanics.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/0643067c91bde4e313de8fbb69cb2e8a999a2427.jpg

The most impressive tank destruction animation ever
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/d6fc3a732faa60450629a538007d9ddc89c9924b.jpg

A campaign with 100 wow moments, we will provide an in game counter of these moments to prove our promise.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/b76d9621a55eaab773042c3bf1493470867de0b8.jpg

For more info and receive the free demo when it's out soon, visit our sites here:

 www.tankbrawl2.com	

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/7086082bc3404acf503320a754530591df496b77.png https://twitter.com/PhungGames	
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/b1766aea2fe709726b5744ea96593815aa71dd7c.png https://www.facebook.com/phunggames


Store page is online now. Add it to your wishlist if you are interested.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/765450/Tank_Brawl_2/

 Thanks for your support so far

notes.title: Free Demo Version Available!
notes.content:
We noticed that there has been thousand of steamers added Tank Brawl to their wishlist, so we decided to add 
 Free TANK BRAWL Demo Version 
This lite version will let you play through some trial levels of the game. 
Simply click the "Download Demo" button to brawl for free !!!
